title: Grimoire Archive: First Steps
summary: Start with the first archive entries and read warning states before acting.

blocks.title: Read The First Signal
blocks.body: Begin with Aether Signal, resonance, and the Veil. These entries teach the language used by later forbidden pages.

blocks.title: Respect Locked Records
blocks.body: A locked record is often a pacing clue. It means the route wants another scan, mission, provider, or field event first.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A clean first Grimoire win is reading one archive and using it to avoid one risky blind test.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
